oracle.managedWritePolicy: inventory but allow runtime_root/control and runtime_root/WAL durability calls exercised by S1 fault and recovery tests
oracle.canonicalAgentContextPolicy: exact /root role identifiers in task_model_roles are identifiers, not filesystem targets

manualBoundaryReview.cleanup: temporary siblings only; no recursive deletion or raw process termination
